env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A block segment lambda of a group stage lowers a nested go group that
# joins before the lambda returns, a function literal with ? inside an
# expression lambda, const if, and scope defer, natively and in the
# ejected module. chain_stage_nested_forms.lgo prints one ok line per
# form.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_nested_forms.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_nested_forms.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_nested_forms.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_nested_forms.out
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstagenestedforms

go 1.27
